scope: Two paired local one-story publication measurements, baseline 2e46fa9 vs current cf6ca33 plus outer diagnostic; real local D1 feed turn, synthetic zero-network ports. Not real inference, remote D1 or end-to-end observation latency.
limitations: Original preliminary pair 1 excluded because its query counters included the subsequent idempotent reuse read. Retained privately.
Returned row bytes include JSON representation of row arrays, not network packets.
Batch statement wall durations overlap; do not sum.
Local D1 did not expose sql_duration_ms. Null SQL CPU means unmeasured, not zero.
No significant full-pipeline speedup established. Small sample is not a p95/p99 estimate.
